ALFRED(1)User commandsALFRED(1)
NAME

alfred, a decision-intelligence chief of staff for your marketing stack.

SYNOPSIS

alfred connect <stack> · alfred brief --at 07:00 · alfred ask "<question>"

QUESTIONS

Does Alfred ship changes on its own?

No. I draft the move and attach the reasoning; nothing reaches a platform until you approve it. Auto-approval thresholds exist, and you set them.

How long does setup take?

One afternoon. You grant the connections, I backfill the history and learn how your organisation decides. The first brief lands the next morning at 07:00.

Where does my data live?

In your stack. I read through the connections you grant, keep an audit line for every read, and never move your data into places you have not named.

What if I disagree with a call?

Tell me. Every recommendation carries its evidence trail, so you can challenge the reasoning line by line, and I learn your thresholds from the verdict.
